headline: Astros beat Phillies 2-1 on late Cam Smith homer
recap: The Phillies fell 2-1 to the Astros on Thursday afternoon at Citizens Bank Park, dropping the finale of the three-game series. Houston struck first in the top of the second when Taylor Trammell's double scored Christian Walker for a 1-0 lead. Philadelphia tied it in the bottom of the fifth when Bryson Stott reached on a fielder's choice that scored Luis Arraez, though Alec Bohm was thrown out trying to advance to third on the same play. The score stayed 1-1 until the top of the ninth, when Cam Smith's solo home run off reliever Jhoan Duran put Houston back ahead for good. Zack Wheeler was excellent in a no-decision, allowing one run over seven innings with nine strikeouts and two walks; Cristian Javier matched him with six innings and one run allowed for Houston. Duran (2-6) took the loss, Bryan Abreu (6-3) picked up the win, and Josh Hader closed it out for his 25th save.
The loss dropped Philadelphia to 82-65, second in the NL East, four games behind the division-leading Braves. The Phillies are on a one-game losing streak.

Philadelphia opens a three-game series at Atlanta on Friday night, with Aaron Nola starting opposite Braves left-hander Chris Sale. First pitch at Truist Park is scheduled for 7:15 PM ET. Atlanta is favored at -191 on the moneyline, with the Braves also -1.5 on the run line (+119).
